description: Catalogs for the sign-language equivalence class the JDK materializes for sgn-be-fr. The range 'sgn-be-fr-x-a' is not a known tag, its JDK rendering (sgn-BE) is LOSSY and therefore appears in none of its identities, and its identity set carries a known member (sfb-x-a) followed by an unknown one (sgn-be-fx-x-a). That ordering is the only shape in which semanticLanguageRangeForDerivedMatching's known-tag rung has to REJECT a later candidate rather than accept it -- an exhaustive sweep of 879,768 range spellings found no other.
